subject: VenStar vendor onboarding — payment terms alignment & PO routing
messages:
From: Amelie Dupont <amelie.dupont@openledger.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@openledger.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: VenStar onboarding - preferred payment terms

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached are the completed vendor onboarding form and our W-9. VenStar is ready to onboard and start delivering as soon as the PO and remittance lane are confirmed. A couple quick asks on our side: 

- Preferred payment terms: Net 30 (VenStar typically runs Net30 for smaller SaaS customers).
- Remittance: ACH preferred (we can provide bank details once vendor is set up on your portal).
- PO header: we typically need a single PO per quarter per contract; can your system support a PO that references multiple invoices?

We can be flexible on the PO cadence but would appreciate confirmation on whether Redwood can make an exception to Net45 and move to Net30 for this relationship. If not, any pathway to shorten to Net30 after an initial period would work.

Attachments: VenStar_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), W-9_OpenLedger.pdf (pdf)

Let me know what you need from our side to keep the activation on track.

Best,
Amelie Dupont
Head of Procurement, OpenLedger Inc.
amelie.dupont@openledger.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amelie Dupont <amelie.dupont@openledger.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VenStar onboarding - preferred payment terms

Hi Amelie — thanks for the form and W-9, got them. Quick responses and next steps below: 

Summary:
- Redwood standard vendor terms are Net45.
- We can consider an exception or a staged acceleration to Net30 after an initial onboarding window.

Can you confirm:
- VenStar bank remittance details (ACH) or if you prefer wire.
- Who defines invoice granularity (one invoice per PO vs multiple invoices per PO).

Next steps from our side: Im looping in David (AP lead) and Sean (vendor ops) to validate whether we can do a Net30 exception or a laddered approach. Kimberly (our vendor portal PM) will confirm PO routing and whether the portal supports multiple invoices against a single PO.

If it helps, we typically propose either:
- Pilot: Net45 for first 60–90 days, then review for Net30; or
- Early settlement enrollment (1% discount for Net15) via our financing partner to simulate earlier cashflow.

Ill follow up once AP confirms the operational path. If you need a faster answer for contract signing, tell me your preferred option and well prioritize.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: VenStar onboarding - preferred payment terms (internal)

Marissa / team — quick AP feasibility note.

- Risk/cashflow: VenStar is a straightforward vendor; low credit concern from our side. However we prefer not to make permanent Net30 exceptions without an onboarding runway (invoice accuracy + PO mapping confirmed).

Proposed operational path (internal):
1) Activation phase (first two invoices): Net60 deferred to allow verification of invoice data and remittance lanes.
2) Standard after verification: Net45 for 30–60 days while automated PO/invoice match is observed.
3) Acceleration: Move to Net30 after 90 days with >=95% invoice match rate and no dispute backlog.

Alternative: Early settlement program — Redwoods partner can provide VenStar with early cash for a small discount (0.5–1%). If VenStar opts in, we can record Net45 on our ledger while they collect earlier.

Im attaching a quick ladder we can share with the vendor to set expectations.

Attachments: payment-ladder-proposal.xlsx

-David
David Kim
Director, Accounts Payable | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amelie Dupont <amelie.dupont@openledger.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, procurement@openledger.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: VenStar onboarding - preferred payment terms

Amelie — thanks, and appreciate the flexibility. After internal review heres the formal onboarding path we can offer so we can get VenStar live without delay: 

1) Activation period (first 60–90 days): Net45 (recorded on our ledger). This allows us to verify PO routing, invoice formatting, and ACH remittance mapping.

2) Acceleration criteria: If the first 90 days show >=95% automated PO/invoice match and fewer than 2 disputes, we will accelerate to Net30. We will notify you 7 days before the change takes effect.

3) Early settlement option: VenStar may enroll in Redwoods early settlement program (optional). Estimated terms: 1% discount for Net15 settlement, or 0.5% for Net30, via our financing partner. Enrollment is vendor-driven; Redwood will share the onboarding link and required bank authorization.

4) PO routing: We will issue PO RDW-98244 for the first contract. Our portal supports multiple invoices against a single PO as long as line-item references are included. Kimberly will share the PO routing doc in a follow-up.

Requested from VenStar to finalize activation:
- Confirm acceptance of the activation path above (Net45 with review to Net30).
- Provide ACH details (or confirm wire) and invoicing contact email.
- Sign the PO acknowledgment via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/po/98244

Quoting Davids note below for detail:
> From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
> Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
> Proposed operational path: Activation Net60 -> Net45 -> Move to Net30 after 90 days with >=95% match rate. Early settlement optional.

If VenStar confirms the ACH details, well issue the PO and kick off vendor portal activation today.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
